This '''house''' was the home of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. It was destroyed during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].
